derivative_definition: (f_plus-f_minus)/(u_plus-u_minus), using actual parameter values; u=log(parameter), except u_beta=log(-log(beta_annual))
asymmetry_definition: difference of raw one-sided slopes; relative absolute difference divided by absolute central slope, undefined only at zero central slope
normalization_note: Every original panel point separately normalizes fertility to 2.1; derivatives are along that normalized candidate path, not holding psi fixed
